video_title: 76ers, Cavs or Warriors? 👀 Who will go ALL-IN for LeBron James? 🎲 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Shams Charania
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James is gathering information on potential free agent destinations
quotes.excerpt: they've been in a process of gathering information and one interesting wrinkle that has occurred
quotes.quote: All of the information so far has funneled through agent Rich Paul with LeBron James. They've been in a process of gathering information and one interesting wrinkle that has occurred in the last several days is some of the leading suitors for LeBron James, whether that's a Golden State, a Cleveland, Miami, Minnesota, Philadelphia, some of them have been able to send a voice note to LeBron James via Rich Paul. So whether it's an owner, a president or general manager, being able to record a voice note, I'm told, send it to Rich Paul and that makes its way to LeBron James. This is just a part of LeBron James's process of studying as he makes a decision. He has not been in a rush, there's been no timetable that he's been operating under.

text_blocks.speaker: Danny Green
text_blocks.text: They have a full house and speaking of the process, the process is now with the big JB. You got the big seven there now, you got V.J. Edgecombe with the 27, so we got three sevens on board. And if you bring the King, you got two Kings. So I don't know how else you do it. You obviously got Tyrese Maxey, you got Joel Embiid. This is a really good set roster, especially when Joel is healthy. You add LeBron James to that, this is an unbelievable hand that you cannot, it's hard to beat.

quotes.speaker: Chiney Ogwumike
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James to the Golden State Warriors is a four-of-a-kind
quotes.excerpt: It is four of a kind because we're talking about four Kings, four championships.
quotes.quote: I'm going to reveal mine. It is four of a kind for LeBron James going to Golden State. It is four of a kind because we're talking about four Kings, four championships. And let's think about just the synergies there. There's a lot of romance brewing. We saw it, it started in Paris, Steph and LeBron. You think about Draymond Green, that's his bestie as well, defensively. This four of a kind is elite, you include Steve Kerr who coached Steph and LeBron, and especially in those big clutch moments.

quotes.speaker: Bobby Marks
quotes.summary_phrase: Cleveland Cavaliers roster construction and potential for LeBron James return
quotes.excerpt: You've got Donovan Mitchell, you've got James Harden who's gone to sign, you've got the bigs
quotes.quote: When you look at Cleveland, you've got Donovan Mitchell, you've got James Harden who's gone to sign, you've got the bigs in Evan Mobley and Jared Allen. You've got the shooters off the bench in Max Strus and Sam Merrill, and young man, it's never too late to go home. There is a path to Cleveland for LeBron James.
